keg.duplicatePolicy: Exclude cards at their collection copy cap; reserve each automatic drop before the next draw. Choice offers have distinct template IDs.
keg.purchasePolicy: Bulk inventory purchase at 150 crowns each, bounded by remaining rare pool minus unopened kegs and one pending opening.
keg.fullCollectionPolicy: Do not sell a keg if no eligible rare card/leader remains. Exhausted bronze does not prevent buying the remaining rares. No excess copies or scraps.
keg.grantPolicy: Consume one inventory keg only at opening, then grant zero to four bronze copies and persist the rare choice. Resume consumes no additional item.
keg.randomPolicy: Progression RNG separated from battle and presentation RNG.
keg.automaticCardsPolicy: Up to four eligible bronze copies. If fewer remain, grant them all; if none remain, grant only the rare choice. Price stays150 crowns, approved by user.
keg.openingAction: Native inventory Use; each opening consumes one keg.
keg.exhaustedAfterPurchase: Return 150 crowns when attempting to open a previously purchased closed keg after other rewards exhausted the rare pool.
